name: Mailchimp MCP
tagline: Manage email campaigns, lists, and subscribers from your AI agent.
shortDescription: The official Mailchimp MCP server. List audiences, create campaigns, send emails, view reports, and manage automations. The canonical way to give an agent access to your email marketing stack.
longDescription:
## What it is

The Mailchimp MCP server, by Intuit (Mailchimp's parent). Exposes the Mailchimp API as MCP tools: list audiences, view subscribers, create campaigns, send emails, manage automations, view reports, and A/B test results.

## Why we recommend it

If your email marketing is on Mailchimp, this is the cleanest way to let your agent help. It can pull subscriber counts, draft campaigns, view open rates, and even trigger automations based on chat commands. The auth is your standard Mailchimp API key.

## When to use it

- Marketing agents: agent drafts campaign copy, pulls performance reports
- List management: agent segments subscribers based on chat-described criteria
- Automation: agent triggers a welcome series or re-engagement flow
- Reporting: agent pulls open/click rates and identifies trends
installInstructions:
1. Get an API key at https://admin.mailchimp.com/account/api/
2. Set `MAILCHIMP_API_KEY=...`
3. `npx -y @mailchimp/mcp-server`

**Security note:** Use a key scoped to read-only or specific scopes. Don't give the agent full send access without human review.
pricingDetails: Free. Mailchimp: free tier for up to 500 contacts. Paid plans from $13/mo.
